column1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C) and grease a 3–4 quart baking dish. Toss the cheddar and Gruyere together in a bowl.
Boil the pasta until one minute short of al dente, drain, toss with the olive oil, and let it cool while you make the sauce.
Melt the butter in a deep pot, whisk in the flour over medium heat, and cook about 1 minute until bubbly and golden.
Slowly whisk in the milk and cream until smooth. Once bubbles appear, keep whisking 2 more minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Whisk in 2 cups of the cheese until smooth, then another 2 cups until thick and creamy.
Fold in the pasta until fully coated.
Spread half the pasta in the dish, cover with the remaining 2 cups cheese, then add the rest of the pasta.
Mix the panko, Parmesan, melted butter, and paprika and scatter over the top. Bake about 30 minutes until bubbly and golden.
